title: restic.prime.v1
description: The repository password store was primed: the password was fetched from the password manager and cached for unattended backups, for ttl seconds.  Emitted on success and on failure.  Subject: which password, 'local' or 'remote' (the repository it opens).  Carries neither the password nor the name of its entry in the password manager.

ttl.description: Seconds the cached password stays valid, counted from the time of priming.

expires.description: RFC 3339 time the cached password stops being valid.

error.description: Why priming failed.  Required when result is fail.
